title: The Rescue Team Sets Out
summary: The Blood Cry Bell, carried only by the Heavenly Ranking's top ten, reports that Mo Longzi and top bounty-list names have trapped Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong in the Fog Valley. Because of a pact with the Dragon Demon Palace that elders will not interfere in the younger generation's fights, Tai Cang sends Mo You with the Penalty Hall and assigns Mu Chen, Luo Li and Su Xuan to Lin Zheng's rescue team. Mu Chen explains to Luo Li that Ling Xi's interest is the pagoda inside him, linked to her lost memories and his mother. Ling Xi leaves her bamboo grove to give him a Level 5 spiritual formation she drew for a life-or-death moment. The briefing profiles Chi Yu (7th), Mao Jiang (8th), Teng Long (6th), Gui Xiong (4th), Mu Gu (3rd), Wu Jia (5th, a formation master) and Mo Longzi, while the Dragon Demon Palace plots to reclaim the Great Xumi Demonic Pillar from Mu Chen. In the Fog Valley a Void Formation Arts array scatters the team.
